entities.summary: Bogdan Macovei is a Romanian-born luger who competed for Moldova. He represented Moldova in three Winter Olympics from 2006 to 2014. He earned his best finish of 30th in the men's singles event at Turin in the 2006 Winter Olympics. He had also competed in multiple FIL World Luge Championships, and Luge World Cups.
